curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: exhibit appropriate eye- hand coordination for writing preparedness

interactions.prompt: Which action prepares your fingers to write?
choices: Open and close your hands gently
interactions.answer: Open and close your hands gently
interactions.feedback: Great warm-up! Gentle finger movement gets your hands ready.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the safe action that moves your fingers.

interactions.prompt: Which picture description shows good eye-hand coordination?
choices: Eyes follow the crayon as the hand draws
Eyes close while the hand draws
The crayon rolls on the floor
interactions.answer: Eyes follow the crayon as the hand draws
interactions.feedback: Correct! Your eyes guide your moving hand.
interactions.retryHint: Your eyes and hand should work together.

interactions.prompt: Put the tracing steps in order.
interactions.feedback: Smooth tracing! You prepared, looked and moved.
interactions.retryHint: Hold first, look next, then move.

interactions.prompt: A bee must reach its flower without leaving the curved path. What should you do?
choices: Follow the curve slowly with your finger
interactions.answer: Follow the curve slowly with your finger
interactions.feedback: Wonderful control! Slow following keeps you on the path.
interactions.retryHint: Let your eyes guide your finger along the curve.

interactions.prompt: Guide a bus through a zigzag road. Arrange the movements.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Your eyes and hand handled changing directions.
interactions.retryHint: Follow the road from its start to the school.

interactions.prompt: Which learner is most ready for careful writing?
choices: Nia watches the line and moves her pencil steadily
Toma grips very hard and scribbles fast
interactions.answer: Nia watches the line and moves her pencil steadily
interactions.feedback: Writing-ready! Nia shows controlled eye-hand coordination.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the learner whose eyes guide a steady hand.
